verses.original: הַחֲרִ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַי֙ אִיִּ֔ים וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֑חַ יִגְּשׁוּ֙ אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ יַחְדָּ֖ו לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט נִקְרָֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥă·rî·šū ’ê·lay ’î·yîm ū·lə·’um·mîm ya·ḥă·lî·p̄ū ḵō·aḥ yig·gə·šū ’āz yə·ḏab·bê·rū yaḥ·dāw lam·miš·pāṭ niq·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Be silent before Me O islands and let the peoples renew their strength Let them come forward and testify let us together draw near for judgment

verses.original: מִ֤י הֵעִיר֙ מִמִּזְרָ֔ח צֶ֖דֶק יִקְרָאֵ֣הוּ לְרַגְל֑וֹ יִתֵּ֨ן לְפָנָ֤יו גּוֹיִם֙ וּמְלָכִ֣ים יַ֔רְדְּ יִתֵּ֤ן כֶּֽעָפָר֙ חַרְבּ֔וֹ כְּקַ֥שׁ נִדָּ֖ף קַשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mî hê·‘îr mim·miz·rāḥ ṣe·ḏeq yiq·rā·’ê·hū lə·raḡ·lōw yit·tên lə·p̄ā·nāw gō·w·yim ū·mə·lā·ḵîm yard yit·tên ke·‘ā·p̄ār ḥar·bōw kə·qaš nid·dāp̄ qaš·tōw
verses.literal: Who has aroused one from the east and called him to his feet in righteousness He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him He turns them to dust with his sword to windblown chaff with his bow

verses.original: יִרְדְּפֵ֖ם יַעֲב֣וֹר שָׁל֑וֹם אֹ֥רַח בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֥א יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: yir·də·p̄êm ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr šā·lō·wm ’ō·raḥ bə·raḡ·lāw lō yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: He pursues them going on safely hardly touching the path with his feet

verses.original: מִֽי־ פָעַ֣ל וְעָשָׂ֔ה קֹרֵ֥א הַדֹּר֖וֹת מֵרֹ֑אשׁ אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ רִאשׁ֔וֹן וְאֶת־ אַחֲרֹנִ֖ים אֲנִי־ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: mî- p̄ā·‘al wə·‘ā·śāh qō·rê had·dō·rō·wṯ mê·rōš ’ă·nî Yah·weh ri·šō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’a·ḥă·rō·nîm ’ă·nî- hū
verses.literal: Who has performed this and carried it out calling forth the generations from the beginning I the LORD the first and the last I am He

verses.original: רָא֤וּ אִיִּים֙ וְיִירָ֔אוּ קְצ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ קָרְב֖וּ וַיֶּאֱתָיֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’ū ’î·yîm wə·yî·rā·’ū qə·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ye·ḥĕ·rā·ḏū qā·rə·ḇū way·ye·’ĕ·ṯā·yūn
verses.literal: The islands see and fear the ends of the earth tremble They approach and come forward

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ יַעְזֹ֑רוּ וּלְאָחִ֖יו יֹאמַ֥ר חֲזָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū ya‘·zō·rū ū·lə·’ā·ḥîw yō·mar ḥă·zāq
verses.literal: Each one helps the other and says to his brother Be strong

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֤ק חָרָשׁ֙ אֶת־ צֹרֵ֔ף מַחֲלִ֥יק פַּטִּ֖ישׁ אֶת־ ה֣וֹלֶם פָּ֑עַם אֹמֵ֤ר לַדֶּ֙בֶק֙ ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַיְחַזְּקֵ֥הוּ בְמַסְמְרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥaz·zêq ḥā·rāš ’eṯ- ṣō·rêp̄ ma·ḥă·lîq paṭ·ṭîš ’eṯ- hō·w·lem pā·‘am ’ō·mêr lad·de·ḇeq ṭō·wḇ hū way·ḥaz·zə·qê·hū ḇə·mas·mə·rîm lō yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: The craftsman encourages the goldsmith and he who wields the hammer cheers him who strikes the anvil saying of the welding It is good He nails it down . . . so it will not be toppled

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדִּ֔י יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחַרְתִּ֑יךָ זֶ֖רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹהֲבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḇ·dî ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·šer bə·ḥar·tî·ḵā ze·ra‘ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ō·hă·ḇî
verses.literal: But you O Israel My servant Jacob whom I have chosen descendant of Abraham My friend

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱזַקְתִּ֙יךָ֙ מִקְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵאֲצִילֶ֖יהָ קְרָאתִ֑יךָ וָאֹ֤מַר לְךָ֙ עַבְדִּי־ אַ֔תָּה בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֥א מְאַסְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî·ḵā miq·ṣō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ū·mê·’ă·ṣî·le·hā qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā wā·’ō·mar lə·ḵā ‘aḇ·dî- ’at·tāh bə·ḥar·tî·ḵā wə·lō mə·’as·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: I brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its farthest corners I said You are My servant I have chosen and not rejected you

verses.original: אַל־ תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י עִמְּךָ־ אָ֔נִי אַל־ תִּשְׁתָּ֖ע כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אִמַּצְתִּ֙יךָ֙ אַף־ עֲזַרְתִּ֔יךָ אַף־ תְּמַכְתִּ֖יךָ בִּימִ֥ין צִדְקִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā kî ‘im·mə·ḵā- ’ā·nî ’al- tiš·tā‘ kî- ’ă·nî ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’im·maṣ·tî·ḵā ’ap̄- ‘ă·zar·tî·ḵā ’ap̄- tə·maḵ·tî·ḵā bî·mîn ṣiḏ·qî
verses.literal: Do not fear for I am with you do not be afraid for I am your God I will strengthen you I will surely help you . . . I will uphold you with My righteous right hand

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יֵבֹ֙שׁוּ֙ וְיִכָּ֣לְמ֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ יִֽהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וְיֹאבְד֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י רִיבֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hên yê·ḇō·šū wə·yik·kā·lə·mū kōl han·ne·ḥĕ·rîm bāḵ yih·yū ḵə·’a·yin wə·yō·ḇə·ḏū ’an·šê rî·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: Behold all who rage against you will be ashamed and disgraced those who contend with you will be reduced to nothing and will perish

verses.original: תְּבַקְשֵׁם֙ וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑ךָ יִהְי֥וּ כְאַ֛יִן וּכְאֶ֖פֶס אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחַמְתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḇaq·šêm wə·lō ṯim·ṣā·’êm ’an·šê maṣ·ṣu·ṯe·ḵā yih·yū ḵə·’a·yin ū·ḵə·’e·p̄es ’an·šê mil·ḥam·te·ḵā
verses.literal: You will seek them . . . but will not find them Those who wage war against you will come to nothing . . .

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מַחֲזִ֣יק יְמִינֶ֑ךָ הָאֹמֵ֥ר לְךָ֛ אַל־ תִּירָ֖א אֲנִ֥י עֲזַרְתִּֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ma·ḥă·zîq yə·mî·ne·ḵā hā·’ō·mêr lə·ḵā ’al- tî·rā ’ă·nî ‘ă·zar·tî·ḵā
verses.literal: For I am the LORD your God who takes hold of your right hand and tells you Do not fear I will help you

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽירְאִי֙ תּוֹלַ֣עַת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב מְתֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עֲזַרְתִּיךְ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגֹאֲלֵ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rə·’î tō·w·la·‘aṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ mə·ṯê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî ‘ă·zar·tîḵ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·ḡō·’ă·lêḵ qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Do not fear O Jacob you worm O few men of Israel I will help you declares the LORD Your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה שַׂמְתִּ֗יךְ לְמוֹרַג֙ חָר֣וּץ חָדָ֔שׁ בַּ֖עַל פִּֽיפִיּ֑וֹת תָּד֤וּשׁ הָרִים֙ וְתָדֹ֔ק וּגְבָע֖וֹת כַּמֹּ֥ץ תָּשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh śam·tîḵ lə·mō·w·raḡ ḥā·rūṣ ḥā·ḏāš ba·‘al pî·p̄î·yō·wṯ tā·ḏūš hā·rîm wə·ṯā·ḏōq ū·ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ kam·mōṣ tā·śîm
verses.literal: Behold I will make you into a threshing sledge new and sharp with many teeth You will thresh the mountains and crush them and reduce the hills to chaff

verses.original: תִּזְרֵם֙ וְר֣וּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵ֔ם וּסְעָרָ֖ה תָּפִ֣יץ אוֹתָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֙ תָּגִ֣יל בַּֽיהוָ֔ה בִּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּתְהַלָּֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: tiz·rêm wə·rū·aḥ tiś·śā·’êm ū·sə·‘ā·rāh tā·p̄îṣ ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’at·tāh tā·ḡîl Yah·weh biq·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl tiṯ·hal·lāl
verses.literal: You will winnow them and a wind will carry them away a gale will scatter them But you will rejoice in the LORD you will glory in the Holy One of Israel

verses.original: הָעֲנִיִּ֨ים וְהָאֶבְיוֹנִ֜ים מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים מַ֙יִם֙ וָאַ֔יִן לְשׁוֹנָ֖ם בַּצָּמָ֣א נָשָׁ֑תָּה אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶעֱנֵ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ă·nî·yîm wə·hā·’eḇ·yō·w·nîm mə·ḇaq·šîm ma·yim wā·’a·yin lə·šō·w·nām baṣ·ṣā·mā nā·šāt·tāh ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’e·‘ĕ·nêm ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lō ’e·‘ez·ḇêm
verses.literal: The poor and needy seek water but there is none their tongues are parched with thirst I the LORD will answer them I, the God of Israel will not forsake them

verses.original: אֶפְתַּ֤ח עַל־ שְׁפָיִים֙ נְהָר֔וֹת וּבְת֥וֹךְ בְּקָע֖וֹת מַעְיָנ֑וֹת אָשִׂ֤ים מִדְבָּר֙ לַאֲגַם־ מַ֔יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִיָּ֖ה לְמוֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ep̄·taḥ ‘al- šə·p̄ā·yîm nə·hā·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ṯō·wḵ bə·qā·‘ō·wṯ ma‘·yā·nō·wṯ ’ā·śîm miḏ·bār la·’ă·ḡam- ma·yim wə·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh lə·mō·w·ṣā·’ê mā·yim
verses.literal: I will open rivers on the barren heights and fountains in the middle of the valleys I will turn the desert into a pool of water and the dry land into flowing springs . . .

verses.original: אֶתֵּ֤ן בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אֶ֣רֶז שִׁטָּ֔ה וַהֲדַ֖ס וְעֵ֣ץ שָׁ֑מֶן אָשִׂ֣ים בָּעֲרָבָ֗ה בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּתְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: ’et·tên bam·miḏ·bār ’e·rez šiṭ·ṭāh wa·hă·ḏas wə·‘êṣ šā·men ’ā·śîm bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh bə·rō·wōš tiḏ·hār ū·ṯə·’aš·šūr yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: I will plant cedars in the wilderness acacias myrtles and olive trees I will set cypresses in the desert elms and boxwood together

verses.original: לְמַ֧עַן יִרְא֣וּ וְיֵדְע֗וּ וְיָשִׂ֤ימוּ וְיַשְׂכִּ֙ילוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֥י יַד־ יְהוָ֖ה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּ֑את וּקְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרָאָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yir·’ū wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū wə·yā·śî·mū wə·yaś·kî·lū yaḥ·dāw kî yaḏ- Yah·weh ‘ā·śə·ṯāh zōṯ ū·qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl bə·rā·’āh
verses.literal: so that all may see and know may consider and understand that the hand of the LORD has done this and the Holy One of Israel has created it

verses.original: קָרְב֥וּ רִֽיבְכֶ֖ם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הַגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ עֲצֻמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם יֹאמַ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·ḇū rî·ḇə·ḵem yō·mar Yah·weh hag·gî·šū ‘ă·ṣu·mō·w·ṯê·ḵem yō·mar me·leḵ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: Present your case says the LORD Submit your arguments says the King of Jacob

verses.original: יַגִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔נוּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְרֶ֑ינָה הָרִאשֹׁנ֣וֹת׀ מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה הַגִּ֜ידוּ וְנָשִׂ֤ימָה לִבֵּ֙נוּ֙ וְנֵדְעָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֔ן א֥וֹ הַבָּא֖וֹת הַשְׁמִיעֻֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yag·gî·šū wə·yag·gî·ḏū lā·nū ’êṯ ’ă·šer tiq·re·nāh hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ māh hên·nāh hag·gî·ḏū wə·nā·śî·māh lib·bê·nū wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯān ’ōw hab·bā·’ō·wṯ haš·mî·‘u·nū
verses.literal: Let them come and tell us what will happen Tell the former things . . . . . . so that we may reflect on them and know the outcome Or announce to us what is coming

verses.original: הַגִּ֙ידוּ֙ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת לְאָח֔וֹר וְנֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אַף־ תֵּיטִ֣יבוּ וְתָרֵ֔עוּ וְנִשְׁתָּ֖עָה וְנִרָא יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū hā·’ō·ṯî·yō·wṯ lə·’ā·ḥō·wr wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh kî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’at·tem ’ap̄- tê·ṭî·ḇū wə·ṯā·rê·‘ū wə·niš·tā·‘āh wə·ni·rå̄ yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Tell us the things that are to come so that we may know that you are gods Yes do something good or evil that we may look on together in dismay . . . . . .

verses.original: הֵן־ אַתֶּ֣ם מֵאַ֔יִן וּפָעָלְכֶ֖ם מֵאָ֑פַע תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה יִבְחַ֥ר בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hên- ’at·tem mê·’a·yin ū·p̄ā·‘ā·lə·ḵem mê·’ā·p̄a‘ tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh yiḇ·ḥar bā·ḵem
verses.literal: Behold you are nothing and your work is of no value Anyone who chooses you is detestable

verses.original: הַעִיר֤וֹתִי מִצָּפוֹן֙ וַיַּ֔את מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֑י וְיָבֹ֤א סְגָנִים֙ כְּמוֹ־ חֹ֔מֶר וּכְמ֥וֹ יוֹצֵ֖ר יִרְמָס־ טִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘î·rō·w·ṯî miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn way·yaṯ mim·miz·raḥ- še·meš yiq·rā ḇiš·mî wə·yā·ḇō sə·ḡā·nîm kə·mōw- ḥō·mer ū·ḵə·mōw yō·w·ṣêr yir·mās- ṭîṭ
verses.literal: I have raised up one from the north and he has come one from the east . . . who calls on My name He will march over rulers as if they were mortar like a potter who treads the clay

verses.original: מִֽי־ הִגִּ֤יד מֵרֹאשׁ֙ וְנֵדָ֔עָה וּמִלְּפָנִ֖ים וְנֹאמַ֣ר צַדִּ֑יק אַ֣ף אֵין־ מַגִּ֗יד אַ֚ף אֵ֣ין מַשְׁמִ֔יעַ אַ֥ף אֵין־ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mî- hig·gîḏ mê·rōš wə·nê·ḏā·‘āh ū·mil·lə·p̄ā·nîm wə·nō·mar ṣad·dîq ’ap̄ ’ên- mag·gîḏ ’ap̄ ’ên maš·mî·a‘ ’ap̄ ’ên- šō·mê·a‘ ’im·rê·ḵem
verses.literal: Who has declared this from the beginning so that we may know and from times past so that we may say He was right . . . No one announced it . . . no one foretold it . . . no one heard your words

verses.original: רִאשׁ֥וֹן לְצִיּ֖וֹן הִנֵּ֣ה הִנָּ֑ם וְלִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ri·šō·wn lə·ṣî·yō·wn hin·nêh hin·nām wə·lî·rū·šā·lim mə·ḇaś·śêr ’et·tên
verses.literal: I was the first to tell Zion Look here they are And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news

verses.original: וְאֵ֙רֶא֙ וְאֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וּמֵאֵ֖לֶּה וְאֵ֣ין יוֹעֵ֑ץ וְאֶשְׁאָלֵ֖ם וְיָשִׁ֥יבוּ דָבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ê·re wə·’ên ’îš ū·mê·’êl·leh wə·’ên yō·w·‘êṣ wə·’eš·’ā·lêm wə·yā·šî·ḇū ḏā·ḇār
verses.literal: When I look there is no one there is no counselor among them when I ask them they have nothing to say . . .

verses.original: הֵ֣ן כֻּלָּ֔ם אָ֥וֶן אֶ֖פֶס מַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם ר֥וּחַ וָתֹ֖הוּ נִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: hên kul·lām ’ā·wen ’e·p̄es ma·‘ă·śê·hem rū·aḥ wā·ṯō·hū nis·kê·hem
verses.literal: See they are all a delusion their works amount to nothing their images are as empty as the wind
